q1_daily_units_one_month.question: Units sold per product and day in August 2026 (the daily-demand fact, one month)

bronze_external.sql:
SELECT o.order_date, i.p_id, SUM(SAFE_CAST(i.qty AS INT64)) AS units
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g07_bronze.order_items` AS i JOIN `data-engineering-i1.g07_bronze.orders` AS o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2

q3_orders_per_month_one_quarter.question: Orders per month in Q3 2026, and what SELECT * with LIMIT costs

bronze_external.sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM `data-engineering-i1.g07_bronze.orders`
WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY 1

native_one_column.sql:
